# segment span

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:segmentSpan`](gmeow-segmentSpan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/segmentSpan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The [`MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) over which this segment applies — a [`TempoMapSegment`](../classes/gmeow-TempoMapSegment.md) or a [`MusicalSegment`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalSegment.md). The domain is deliberately left open so the same property serves both time and structure layers; each layer construres its use in SHACL ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:segmentSpan`](gmeow-segmentSpan.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan`](../classes/gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
